# Nuto

> Nuto (https://nuto.dev) is a free URL shortener built so that links shared on social media escape in-app browsers. When someone taps a Nuto link inside Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or another app's built-in web view, Nuto sends them to their real browser or straight into the native app (for example YouTube or Spotify) instead.

Nuto is a personal, non-commercial project by Andres Estrada. It's open source, runs on Cloudflare Workers, and is available in English and Spanish.

## What it does

- **Escapes in-app browsers.** Nuto detects in-app browsers from the user agent (Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Threads, TikTok, X, Snapchat, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Pinterest, Reddit, Discord, LINE, WeChat and others). On iOS it reopens the link in Safari (`x-safari-https://…`); on Android it hands it to the default browser with an intent.
- **Opens links in their apps.** On Android, links to 20+ apps open in the app instead of the web from any browser, falling back to the web when it isn't installed: YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Deezer, Amazon Music, Twitch, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, Amazon, Mercado Libre and Google Maps. On iOS, YouTube, Spotify and WhatsApp links open their apps from in-app browsers, and other links go to Safari. Computers get a normal redirect.
- **Custom short codes.** Users pick an alphanumeric short code or get a random one, e.g. `nuto.dev/mytrack`.
- **Password-protected links.** Visitors must enter a password before being redirected. Passwords are hashed with salted PBKDF2, and attempts are rate limited.
- **Expiring links.** A link can expire at a set date and time. After that it answers with HTTP 410 Gone.
- **Click counts.** The dashboard shows the number of clicks and the last click for each link.

## Pricing and limits

- Free, with no paid tier. Creating links requires a free account (sign-in by Clerk).
- Each account has a link limit.
- Only `http` and `https` destinations are accepted.

## Privacy

- For each click, Nuto stores only the timestamp, the country derived by Cloudflare and a truncated user agent.
- IP addresses are never stored in application data.
- Link passwords are stored hashed (and encrypted so the owner can see them), never in plaintext.

## En español

Nuto está disponible en español (español neutro latinoamericano). Es un acortador de links gratuito: los links que se comparten en redes se saltan el navegador interno de Instagram, TikTok o Facebook y abren el navegador de verdad o la app nativa (por ejemplo YouTube o Spotify). Incluye links con contraseña, links con fecha de vencimiento y conteo de clics, sin guardar direcciones IP.

- [Inicio](https://nuto.dev/es): qué hace Nuto y cómo empezar
- [Política de privacidad](https://nuto.dev/es/privacy): datos que se procesan, cookies y terceros
- [Aviso legal](https://nuto.dev/es/disclaimer): uso aceptable y cómo reportar un link abusivo

## Reporting abuse

To report a short link that distributes malware or phishing, or that points to pirated content, open an issue at https://github.com/andesvel/nuto/issues with the short code and the reason.
